method: Target ROI crop edit from exact source-pixel hand frame, enlarged 8x nearest-neighbor for model input

source_reference.method: Exact crop of body_full.png; 8x nearest-neighbor only, no image content added.

review: Rejected: the model expanded and redrew the cuff/arm beyond the source ROI, made the hand adult-long and oversized, changed fabric proportions/linework, and rendered the checkerboard as opaque RGB pixels. Several digits are visible, but the target/source/style/alpha gates fail.

post_rubric_review.criterion: at least three clearly separated rounded fingertip lobes; fourth may naturally overlap
post_rubric_review.result: digit-count roughly passes as a concept, but overall candidate rejected for pose, scale, cuff redraw, style, and opaque background
